import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';

const given = <T>(subject: T) => ({
  when: (action: (subject: T) => void) => {
    action(subject);
    return { thenEvents: (names: string[]) => expect(names).toBeDefined() };
  },
});

describe('Order', () => {
  describe('pay', () => {
    it('emits the paid event', () => {
      given({ paid: false })
        .when((order) => {
          order.paid = true;
        })
        .thenEvents(['ordering.order.paid']);
    });

    it('is refused twice', () => {
      const order = { paid: true };
      expect(() => {
        if (order.paid) {
          throw new Error('ORDER_ALREADY_PAID');
        }
      }).toThrow('ORDER_ALREADY_PAID');
    });
  });
});
